name: Happy Path — Employment Letter Request
goal: User successfully requests an employment letter and receives confirmation.
constraints: Employee details are present and valid. User selects 'hropsempletter' as the option. All workflows succeed.

phases.description: Bot fetches employee details and displays them for review.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays employee details in plain text with options including 'hropsempletter'.
Bot triggers mail workflow silently and, upon success, displays the exact confirmation message.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
